higgsfield.brand_context: Love Hurts is controlled romantic urban cinema: defiance inside fractured civic architecture, red emergency light, enchanted drama, customer dignity, and exact luxury streetwear product clarity.
higgsfield.product_context: Preserve the exact LH-003 four-view construction without mirroring. The shorts use white perforated mesh with an all-over orange-red rose-bouquet-on-cloud field, a black ribbed waistband, and angular black leg binding traced by red and white stripes. Pocket topology is invariant: exactly four zippered pockets total, comprising two side hand pockets and two rear pockets; every pocket must visibly retain its zipper closure. The wearer-left front/side carries the large red Love Hurts script and a black-mesh inset with the smaller Love Hurts rose/heart emblem. The wearer-right black-mesh inset carries the embroidered red rose bouquet with green stems and a white-and-blue cloud. The back has two black-trimmed zippered rear pockets plus a large red-and-black wearer-left Love Hurts treatment. Do not render open welts, zipperless pockets, cargo pockets, patch pockets, or any extra pocket. The collection-world reference supplies architecture and lighting only; its word sculpture and star/heart monument are forbidden. Use no customer identity until founder-approved on-model authority and a protected garment matte are bound.
